_about: The adopting system's confirmation list (spec 3.3, 4.2.1). Not part of the MCP tool definition. Each entry is one labelled line of a tool's description, word for word, and the form the gate compares it in, as the provider confirmed it. A line that is not here, word for word, is not confirmed: it is unverified and goes back to the provider. So a reworded line voids its own confirmation.
